evidence: Implements consensus rules in src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/validation.cpp for BIP460 witness version 2 script execution and signature verification.
rationale: Provides a reference implementation for BIP460 cross-input signature aggregation consensus rules to address linear fee growth in multi-input Taproot spends. As a reference implementation accompanying early draft BIPs (restricted to regtest), review is valuable for protocol evaluation but reasonably deferrable.
